workspaceGuide.title: Start with the reader surface
workspaceGuide.description: Daily rows are selected by the app; they are not complete standalone articles.

surfaces.title: Daily At-a-Glance
surfaces.description: You and a selected friend each receive their own card.

surfaces.title: Today between you two
surfaces.description: One shared reading on Friends > selected person.

workspaceGuide.noteTitle: Can I add a new daily row?
workspaceGuide.noteBody: Each row must match a selector the app already knows how to request. Edit an existing row to change current output. A newly invented key will not appear to readers until its selector or variant is wired into the resolver, so Content Studio does not offer a misleading free-form “add row” action here.

shared.headlineHint: Used to identify this source in Content Studio. Readers do not see this label.
shared.summaryHint: Describe where this source belongs. Readers do not see this note.
shared.bodyHint: This is the exact saved copy the fallback system can insert into a reader-facing result.

grammarRules.noun_phrase: Write a lowercase phrase that can sit inside a larger sentence. Do not add a final period.
grammarRules.complete_sentence: Write a complete reader-facing sentence with normal capitalization and punctuation.
grammarRules.default: Write copy that fits naturally into the surrounding sentence. Reader Preview shows the full result.

daily.title: {{selector}} · Daily At-a-Glance
daily.description: Shown on You > Daily At-a-Glance and on a selected friend’s Daily card. The app first chooses the Moon’s tightest applying contact to a natal point; when none qualifies, it uses the Moon’s current house. This row is the {{kind}} for the {{selectorLower}}.
daily.headlineRule: Write one short, complete headline in plain language. Do not name the Moon, aspect, point, or house—the reader sees guidance, not the selection rule.
daily.passageRule: Write one complete, concrete daily passage in plain language. Do not name the Moon, aspect, point, or house—the reader sees guidance, not the selection rule.
daily.summaryHint: Package provenance and review history. Readers never see it; leave it unchanged unless you are documenting editorial provenance.
daily.bodyYouHint: Used on the signed-in reader’s Daily At-a-Glance card.
daily.bodyTheyHint: Used for the selected person’s Daily card. Keep the meaning parallel to You; person-name variables are filled by the app.
daily.headlineAssembly: Moon-driven selector → this headline → Daily At-a-Glance card. The headline and passage are selected as a matching pair.
daily.passageAssembly: Moon-driven selector → this passage → Daily At-a-Glance card. The headline and passage are selected as a matching pair.

pairDaily.title: Today between you two source
pairDaily.summaryHint: Package provenance and review history. Readers never see it; leave it unchanged unless you are documenting editorial provenance.

clause.area: Today between you two · personal clause
clause.description: One Moon-driven ingredient for Friends > selected person > Today between you two. The app selects one clause for you and one for your friend, then inserts both into an opening frame.
clause.writingRule: Write a short clause that fits inside a larger sentence. Keep You and Friend parallel; do not add dates, transit windows, or a standalone headline.
clause.assembly: Your daily driver + friend’s daily driver → two personal clauses → opening frame.
clause.you: Inserted as your side of the shared daily sentence.
clause.they: Inserted as the selected friend’s side of the shared daily sentence.

opener.area: Today between you two · opening frame
opener.description: The main sentence frame for the shared daily reading. The app fills it with the selected You and Friend clauses and, for some frames, a shared clause.
opener.writingRule: Write a complete frame and preserve every {{slot}}. The app replaces the handles and clauses; removing a slot removes that part of the reading.
opener.assembly: Selected personal clauses → this opening frame → optional shared bridge → optional closing advice.
opener.you: Primary frame used for the reader-facing shared daily passage.
opener.they: Parallel reference where supplied; the pair surface normally assembles one shared passage.

shared-bond.area: Today between you two · shared bond bridge
shared-bond.description: Optional shared context chosen when a current bond transit is the strongest shared signal between both charts.
shared-bond.writingRule: Write a complete bridge and preserve {{bondClause}}. It must follow the opening naturally and work without a date or transit-window explanation.
shared-bond.assembly: Strongest shared bond transit → this bridge + matching bond detail.
shared-bond.you: Shared bridge in the combined reading.

bond-clause.area: Today between you two · bond detail
bond-clause.description: A planet-specific detail inserted into the matching soft or hard shared-bond bridge.
bond-clause.writingRule: Write a short phrase or clause that fits inside the shared bridge. Do not repeat the opening or add a date.
bond-clause.assembly: Strongest bond planet + soft/hard family → this detail → shared-bond bridge.

shared-moon.area: Today between you two · shared Moon bridge
shared-moon.description: Optional shared context used when the current Moon contacts both charts and no stronger bond-transit bridge is selected.
shared-moon.writingRule: Write one complete shared sentence. Keep it relational and concrete; do not explain the underlying calculation.
shared-moon.assembly: Shared Moon element → this bridge after the opening.
shared-moon.you: Shared bridge in the combined reading.

close.area: Today between you two · closing advice
close.description: Optional final advice used only for a hard shared Saturn or Mercury bond signal.
close.writingRule: Write one concise, actionable closing sentence that can follow the shared bridge.
close.assembly: Hard Saturn or Mercury shared signal → this final sentence.
close.you: Closing advice in the combined reading.

houseHoroscope.title: {{planet}} in {{sign}} · {{house}}
houseHoroscope.description: This saved passage appears when this Sky placement activates the matching house in the signed-in reader’s chart.
houseHoroscope.writingRule: Write one complete second-person passage. Speak directly to the reader as “you” and make the house topic concrete.
houseHoroscope.bodyYouHint: Shown in the personal Sky feed after the app calculates which house this placement activates for the reader.
houseHoroscope.bodyTheyHint: Friend and relationship readings use separate source families.
houseHoroscope.audienceHint: This exact Current Sky record speaks to the signed-in reader. Friends also has horoscope content, but it uses separate They-facing transit-house and relationship sources; those records are edited separately.

retroArticle.title: {{subject}} retrograde article source
retroArticle.description: This is the complete saved source used by the planet retrograde article resolver. Reader Preview fills the date window and planet-in-sign reference so you can review the exact assembled result.
retroArticle.writingRule: Write a complete headline and passage. Keep {{timeOpen}} and {{transitRef}} in the passage; the app replaces them with the live retrograde dates and planet-in-sign reference.
retroArticle.headlineHint: Shown as the headline of the retrograde article.
retroArticle.bodyYouHint: This is the passage the current retrograde article resolver renders.
retroArticle.bodyTheyHint: The current article resolver does not read this field. Keep it aligned only as a reference copy.

planetMode.title: What {{subject}} represents for each person
planetMode.description: The app inserts this short {{subject}} phrase into a larger sentence that compares two planets. The phrase is never shown by itself.
planetMode.writingRule: {{grammarRule}} Keep the You and They versions parallel.
planetMode.example: …an intense connection between {{bodyYou}} and the other planet’s role.
planetMode.bodyYouHint: Used when the reading speaks directly to the person viewing their own chart.
planetMode.bodyTheyHint: Used for the other person in the same relationship sentence.

relationship.writingRule: {{grammarRule}} Keep the You and They versions parallel.
relationship.bodyYouHint: Used when the reading speaks directly to the person viewing their own chart.
relationship.bodyTheyHint: Used when the same idea describes the other person.

planet-ask.title: What {{subject}} needs from a relationship
planet-ask.description: The app inserts this phrase into a larger compatibility passage when it describes what one person needs from the connection.

planet-grates.title: What can frustrate {{subject}}
planet-grates.description: The app inserts this phrase into a larger compatibility passage when it describes relationship friction.

planet-scene.title: How {{subject}} can appear in daily life
planet-scene.description: The app inserts this example into a larger compatibility passage to make the relationship dynamic concrete.

defaults.title: {{subject}} · {{family}}
defaults.description: The app uses this saved source when it assembles {{areaLower}}. Read the complete result in Reader Preview before editing this atomic source.
defaults.bodyYouHint: Used when the app speaks directly to the reader.
defaults.bodyTheyHint: Used when the app describes another person.
